claims: Shrinking Season 3 premiered on Apple TV+ on January 28, 2026.
Shrinking Season 3 had a special one-hour premiere.
New episodes of Shrinking Season 3 were released weekly on Wednesdays.
Episode 11 of Shrinking Season 3 is titled "And That's Our Time".
Episode 11 of Shrinking Season 3 aired on April 8, 2026.
Shrinking was originally envisioned as a three-season arc.
Shrinking has already been renewed for a Season 4.
